E1, E3, and E4 are general background or focus on as-cast structures and composition screening, providing no specific support for the key mechanistic premises.
premises: Thermal exposure coarsens and chemically segregates initially metastable intermetallic compounds in Mg-containing lightweight HEAs
Mg segregates away from the solid-solution matrix while passivating elements like Ti concentrate in secondary phases
This redistribution promotes formation of a denser, more protective oxide scale during high-temperature oxidation
The modified microstructure shifts local electrochemical behavior to improve corrosion resistance relative to the as-cast state
